Data:R.maggephenemysteries.json.label: Subject: Maggephene Mysteries
Data:R.maggephenemysteries.json.desc: 'The greater plagues may not be cured, only bound. The very greatest of all may only be entreated… and it is death to do so improperly.'

Data:R.mandaic.json.label: Subject: Deep Mandaic
Data:R.mandaic.json.desc: The most secret script of the innermost rites of the deep sects of the deep desert. The birth-tongue, it is claimed, of the Mother of Ants herself.

Data:R.orchids.narcotics.json.label: Subject: Orchids & Narcotics
Data:R.orchids.narcotics.json.desc: There is no greed without beauty.

Data:R.ouranoscopy.json.label: Subject: Ouranoscopy
Data:R.ouranoscopy.json.desc: 'Consider the Star. Hath each Star, its Seven Names. Observe that these Names are Never Shared.' - Thomas Dewulf

Data:R.path.pilgrim.json.label: Subject: Path & Pilgrim
Data:R.path.pilgrim.json.desc: 'The traveller is always returning. One who does not is no traveller.' - Arun Peel

Data:R.pearl.tide.json.label: Subject: Pearl & Tide
Data:R.pearl.tide.json.desc: The depths of the sea, the waves upon the shore, and the memories of their withdrawal.

Data:R.pentiments.precursors.json.label: Subject: Pentiments & Precursors
Data:R.pentiments.precursors.json.desc: Feats and feits of forgotten things: the Carapace Cross, the line of Antaios, the world of a low red sun. 'Though much is taken, much abides.'

Data:R.preliminalmeter.json.label: Subject: Preliminal Meter
Data:R.preliminalmeter.json.desc: 'Nine modes, nine horizons': the subtle rhythms of words which open ways.

Data:R.purifications.exaltations.json.label: Subject: Purifications & Exaltations
Data:R.purifications.exaltations.json.desc: 'No-one ever truly wants to be truly changed. Azoth and refulgin are justly feared. But no-one who has been changed would choose to go back.' - George Collers

Data:R.pyroglyphics.json.label: Subject: Pyroglyphics
Data:R.pyroglyphics.json.desc: 'One script that all the world must read, even the blind, and it is written in flames.' Matters of fireworks and their kin - lights, colours, infernal detonations.

Data:R.quenchings.quellings.json.label: Subject: Quenchings & Quellings
Data:R.quenchings.quellings.json.desc: Arts which quench fires and bring solace to the troubled mind. 'A true adept is never troubled by fire, nor by fever, nor by restless spirit.' - Ambrose Westcott

Data:R.raggedcrossroads.json.label: Subject: Ragged Crossroads
Data:R.raggedcrossroads.json.desc: 'To understand why four paths were not taken.'

Data:R.ramsund.json.label: Subject: Ramsund
Data:R.ramsund.json.desc: This language has been called 'mantiq al-tair' and 'lenga aucel' and 'the speech of birds' and 'Ramsund' and 'the hazelnut tongue', but it's a language of secrets, and its true name may never be used. The aviform Hours use it at their Roost, or so the story goes.

Data:R.resurgences.emergences.json.label: Subject: Resurgences & Emergences
Data:R.resurgences.emergences.json.desc: Birth and death are only directions. Between the two we find a crossroads.

Data:R.rhyme.remembrance.json.label: Subject: Rhyme & Remembrance
Data:R.rhyme.remembrance.json.desc: To speak with the dead; to torment the living; to celebrate both.

Data:R.rites.theroots.json.label: Subject: Rites of the Roots
Data:R.rites.theroots.json.desc: The oldest Hours are the gods-from-blood, who rose from sacrifice. That blood was always spilt on the roots, and the rites of its spilling are still remembered.

Data:R.sabazine.json.label: Subject: Sabazine
Data:R.sabazine.json.desc: There is a History where Alexander defeated first the Great Knot of Sabazos, and then the King of Kings. There is another History where, instead, he learnt from them. How many more? If we curl our hands into the correct shapes, we may yet understand.

Data:R.sacralimiae.json.label: Subject: Sacra Limiae
Data:R.sacralimiae.json.desc: The rites of an order of immortals who have tried to remain apart. These rites touch on secrets of Hours of the Mansus - chiefly gods-who-were-flesh and gods-from-Light.

Data:R.sacrasolisinvicti.json.label: Subject: Sacra Solis Invicti
Data:R.sacrasolisinvicti.json.desc: The rites of the Church of the Unconquered Sun, and certain secrets of the gods-from-Light.

Data:R.sandstories.json.label: Subject: Sand Stories
Data:R.sandstories.json.desc: Of wandering tribes, watchful vagabonds, and winged devourers.

Data:R.seastories.json.label: Subject: Sea Stories
Data:R.seastories.json.desc: The sea has always been the widest road.

Data:R.serpents.venoms.json.label: Subject: Serpents & Venoms
Data:R.serpents.venoms.json.desc: These are the Mother's neglected children, and we prefer that they pass not through any door.

Data:R.sharps.json.label: Subject: Sharps
Data:R.sharps.json.desc: Knives, dangers, and things out of place.

Data:R.sickle.eclipse.json.label: Subject: Sickle & Eclipse
Data:R.sickle.eclipse.json.desc: Salt and silver; balance, necessity and rebuke.

Data:R.sights.sensations.json.label: Subject: Sights & Sensations
Data:R.sights.sensations.json.desc: To mix the rarest colours, a merciless detachment is required.

Data:R.skystories.json.label: Subject: Sky Stories
Data:R.skystories.json.desc: The nine winds gossip, and sometimes we can listen.

Data:R.solutions.separations.json.label: Subject: Solutions & Separations
Data:R.solutions.separations.json.desc: The surgeon plies the knife and the mason plies the chisel. There are subtler tools than either.

Data:R.spices.savours.json.label: Subject: Spices & Savours
Data:R.spices.savours.json.desc: There is no sacrifice without sustenance.

Data:R.stitching.binding.json.label: Subject: Stitching & Binding
Data:R.stitching.binding.json.desc: Nothing is entirely broken nor entirely whole - not so long as we have our needles.

Data:R.stonestories.json.label: Subject: Stone Stories
Data:R.stonestories.json.desc: Of the earth, of its forms, of dwellers living and dead.

Data:R.strings.songs.json.label: Subject: Strings & Songs
Data:R.strings.songs.json.desc: The harmonies of the lower skies are here reproduced.

Data:R.surgeries.exsanguinations.json.label: Subject: Surgeries & Exsanguinations
Data:R.surgeries.exsanguinations.json.desc: Surgery entails the flow of blood, and the flow of blood entails purification, but the door also opens the other way.

Data:R.thegreatsignsandthegreatscars.jso.label: Subject: The Great Signs and the Great Scars
Data:R.thegreatsignsandthegreatscars.jso.desc: Some glyphs are too obscure to reside in any language, but too potent to remain unwritten.

Data:R.transformations.liberations.json.label: Subject: Transformations & Liberations
Data:R.transformations.liberations.json.desc: Forge and Moth are less different than we think. Every change is in some way a release.

Data:R.tridesmahiera.json.label: Subject: Tridesma Hiera
Data:R.tridesmahiera.json.desc: The rites of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot, which include certain mysteries of the dwellers in the Wood behind the World.

Data:R.vak.json.label: Subject: Vak
Data:R.vak.json.desc: Before gods arose from blood, before ever ape stood upright, this was the language heard in the House of the Sun.... 'I am Vak,' the Peacock Door boasted, 'both the tongue and the Goddess. I am the only entrance into secret light. I was worshipped before you upright apes, and I will be still when all of you are ugly ash. Listen, and I will prove it.'

Data:R.watchmansparadoxes.json.label: Subject: Watchman's Paradoxes
Data:R.watchmansparadoxes.json.desc: 'That amber preserves and is preserved by light; that to hatch is not to die; that the Sun.' There is a place behind the world called the Mansus. Deeds that would be impossible in the world are inevitable there. The Watchman, who knows all the ways of the Mansus, also knows how to make these deeds possible in the waking world.
